title: Plan §5 sizes the zap against the full Balancer pool (~33.8k/34.8k) but the cutover seeds the V2 pair with only the protocol's 62.9% of BPT (~19.1k sUSDS / 21.9k phUSD per side, ~1.59x shallower): phUSD crosses $1 at a ~$636 zap, not ~$1k, so the intended no-ceiling arb skim on POL is larger than the plan states
description: Not story-unsafe (deliberate design cost; arbitrageur posts $1 collateral per phUSD — per project memory this is closer to accepted design cost than loss). Surfaced because the depth premise is wrong. Depends on the open question whether EOA 0xc65f...e8db (37.1% BPT) migrates. Also corrects the depth premise used in DEDUP-20-03.
impact: Plan §5 sizes zaps against full Balancer depth (~33.8k/34.8k) but the V2 seed is the protocol's 62.9% (~19.1k sUSDS / 21.9k phUSD): phUSD crosses $1 at a ~$636 zap, not ~$1k, so the intended POL arb skim per zap is larger than the plan states.
attackPath: Keeper sizes zaps per plan -> overshoots $1 -> arbitrageurs skim the excess from POL (intended mechanism, mis-sized)
likelihood: medium if plan numbers are used as-is
severityJustification: Planning-document premise error affecting operator sizing of an intended (by-design) arb skim on POL; not a code defect and the skim itself is designed behaviour. Informational, carried in the QA bundle with sizing guidance (chunk pool() so post-zap spot <= $1).
recommendation: Redo plan §5 at 62.9% depth or resolve the EOA question before Stage 2; keeper chunks pool() so post-zap spot <= $1.
knownIssueCheck: No KI match. Not a 'externally-derived yield' opportunity-cost item: it concerns POL arb skim sizing vs plan, kept as economic-premise / operational footgun at Informational.
planPremise: BalancerWinddownPlan §5 worked example (X ≈ 33,804, Y ≈ 34,817) vs 62.9% protocol BPT seed (~19.1k sUSDS / 21.9k phUSD)
